items.title: Vintage Floral Border Medallion DXF Slatted Door Panel
items.description: A free, classic scrollwork border frames a panel of open horizontal slats interrupted by a single ornate floral medallion. This restrained, vintage-inspired layout keeps most of the cutting simple while the decorative frame and medallion carry the visual weight, ideal for a timeless gate or fence insert.

items.title: Basket Weave DXF Pattern for Diagonal Panel Screens
items.description: Diagonal rectangular strips cross over one another in a traditional basket-weave rhythm that repeats evenly across the whole panel. The precise woven geometry suits modern doors and interior room dividers.

items.title: Ornate Butterfly Garden DXF Panel for Laser-Cut Screens
items.description: Free to download, this piece has large decorative butterflies with patterned wings layered among smaller floral accents and droplet shapes, creating a whimsical garden scene across both panels. The mix of scale between the big central butterflies and the smaller surrounding details keeps the composition dynamic and playful.
